title: Add JMAP Quotas reference and note to main spec
description: Add a note in the Capability or Blob Storage section of draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 stating that servers SHOULD implement the JMAP Quota extension (draft-ietf-jmap-quotas-12) and include 'Message', 'Chat', and 'Space' in quota datatypes. No new spec required — just a normative reference and informative note, similar to existing Space/RFC9670 and Space/FileNode notes.
